Subject: Helix Health — Marketplace private offer: PO reconciliation & billing cutover

Hi Lisa,

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. To keep momentum on the private-offer renewal and the capacity uplift, I want to align on two operational items so we can complete Marketplace procurement this week:

1) PO number and effective billing date
   - Can you confirm the PO number Helix will issue (we had a temporary ref 00321 during procurement call) and the desired billing start date for the renewed/private-offer term?

2) Term and capacity change
   - Redwood has the private offer drafted for an 18-month term (to match the committed pricing band) with a bumped capacity from 120k to 175k inference units/month. Please confirm if Helix wants to keep 18 months or switch back to 12.

3) Sign-off method and invoice cadence
   - We can accept a signed PO via DocuSign (link below) or a PDF PO scanned to procurement@redwoodinference.com. For invoicing, do you prefer an annual invoice or quarterly? If quarterly, please confirm the billing contact and remit-to details.

I attached a short PO template that our finance team prefers — if Helix sends your existing PO that's fine too. Once we have the PO and billing date, I'll loop in Marissa (cc'd) to issue the private-offer at AWS Marketplace and kick off the invoice schedule.

DocuSign (optional): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcd-1234-helix

Next steps: if you can reply with PO number + billing start date + preferred invoice cadence, we will finalize paperwork and provide the signed private offer by end of day Friday.

Thanks,

Markus Klein
Sr. Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com

Markus —

Thanks for the note and the template. Confirming a few items from our side:

- PO number: HEL-PO-00321 (attached official PO PDF).
- Billing start date: 2027-09-01 (Helix wants the renewal to align with the start of our fiscal quarter).
- Term: procurement prefers 12 months, but I will confirm with finance today — we may accept 18 months if pricing is locked in.
- Invoice cadence: quarterly is preferred. Billing contact is: Lisa Nguyen (billing@helixhealth.com) + remit-to details in the attached PO.

Can you confirm whether moving to 18 months requires a revised marketplace private-offer or just an amended PO? Also confirm when Redwood will publish the private-offer to AWS so our marketplace team can match the submission.

Lisa —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the PO PDF. Short answers to your questions:

- 18-month vs 12-month: Changing term from 12 to 18 months does require issuing an amended private-offer on the marketplace (pricing band is tied to term length). If Helix wants 18 months, we will update the private-offer and re-issue it for signature. If you confirm 12 months, we can proceed with the current private-offer draft.

- Marketplace publication timing: once we receive the signed PO (PDF or DocuSign) and confirmed billing start date, Redwood will submit the private-offer to AWS within 24 business hours. AWS then typically processes acceptance within 2–3 business days; we'll monitor and share the acceptance ID.

- Invoice cadence and remit: we will issue quarterly invoices. Marissa (cc) will own the invoice schedule and can work with your billing contact for remit instructions.

Proposed next steps (recommended):
1) If you want 18 months, reply-all confirming term = 18 months. We'll prepare the amended private-offer and send the DocuSign link for signature.
2) If staying at 12 months, please return the attached PO signed and we'll submit to AWS.
3) Marissa will confirm Redwood's remit details and calendar the first invoice for 2027-09-01.

I'll prepare the amended private-offer doc now and hold until I get confirmation.

Best,

Markus
